QueueGo.subtitle: High-Performance Pub/Sub Broker
QueueGo.customDescription: A lightweight Pub/Sub message broker written in Go over a custom TCP protocol (Blink). Supports persistent queues via BadgerDB and JWT-based authentication.

Blink.subtitle: Lightweight TCP Messaging Protocol
Blink.customDescription: A lightweight, language-agnostic TCP messaging protocol designed for high-performance publish/subscribe distributed systems with minimal network overhead.

LLM-based-Assessment-of-Software-Project.displayTitle: LLM Assessment of Software Project Ideas
LLM-based-Assessment-of-Software-Project.subtitle: Bachelor's Thesis Research Project
LLM-based-Assessment-of-Software-Project.customDescription: An automated evaluation pipeline leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to assess and score student project proposals in higher-education software project management courses.

AIR-Project.subtitle: TU Graz Graduate Project
AIR-Project.customDescription: Information retrieval and ranking pipeline implementation exploring inverted index structures, BM25 scoring, neural dense retrieval, and evaluation metrics.

BI---Data-Analytics.subtitle: TU Vienna Course Project
BI---Data-Analytics.customDescription: Comprehensive data analytics workflows including data warehouse dimensional modeling, ETL pipelines, clustering, and predictive classification algorithms.

Personal-Website.subtitle: Interactive Vanilla Web Architecture
Personal-Website.customDescription: Modern responsive portfolio website built with pure HTML5, CSS3, dynamic Canvas animations, and automated GitHub repository synchronization workflows.

Team-Creator.subtitle: Android Team Balancing Application
Team-Creator.customDescription: Native Android mobile application designed to generate balanced sports and game teams with custom player ratings and algorithmic distribution.
